meta_analysis.why: pools multiple studies and reports a combined estimate

guideline.why: a body reviewing the whole evidence base issued a recommendation

trial.why: randomised or controlled — the design that can establish an effect

observational.why: measures association in a real population; confounding is possible

review.why: summarises a field rather than adding a measurement

methodological.why: proposes a method rather than a finding about the world

theoretical.why: argues from theory rather than from data

case_report.why: one case; cannot support a general claim

patent.why: evidence that somebody is building it, not that it works
